messages.text: Map the chain from a Wireless Communication market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer.

### Chain map
| Wireless Communication market requirement | Measurable parameter / test need | Required capability of Signal Generator | Required capability of Signal Analyzer | Evidence / limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 【推論】Wi‑Fi 7 ODM/OEM demand is driven by IEEE 802.11be upgrades including 320 MHz channel bandwidth, 4096‑QAM, MLO, 6 GHz, and thermal design issues; the measurable parameters are 320 MHz bandwidth, 4096‑QAM modulation, and MLO / multiple RF chains; the Signal Generator side needs IEEE 802.11be waveform capability and RF modulation bandwidth that covers 320 MHz, while the Signal Analyzer side needs WLAN/802.11be analysis plus analysis bandwidth that covers 320 MHz. | 320 MHz channel bandwidth, 4096‑QAM, MLO / multiple RF chains, and 6 GHz operation are listed as Wi‑Fi 7 technical requirements or test challenges.[25][95] | R&S SMW200A product facts confirm internal digital standards include IEEE 802.11be, and its wideband baseband can provide up to 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth.[73][10] | R&S FSW product facts confirm WLAN options include K91BE, and analysis bandwidth options include R&S FSW‑B320 for 320 MHz analysis bandwidth.[79][80] | The passages do not directly state a SMW200A Wi‑Fi 7 320 MHz test configuration or option stack, and the Wi‑Fi 7 market page should not be merged with R&S solution pages as a verified product-market fit.[38] |
| 【推論】LEO / Direct‑to‑Cell / NTN demand requires RF satellite-link emulation; the measurable parameters are long path delay, Doppler, pathloss, atmospheric effects, and trajectory-dependent fading; the Signal Generator / channel-emulator side needs dynamic fading, long delay, Doppler, and trajectory-based fading-file support. | NTN testing must add high path loss, Doppler shift, time delay, delay variance, atmospheric effects, Faraday effect, scintillation, and weather influences.[42] | R&S SMW200A NTN E2E testing requires firmware version ≥ 5.30 and B14 or B15 with R&S SMW‑K820 customized dynamic fading, supporting satellite trajectory modeling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, longer path delays, enhanced Doppler, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler.[5] | For this E2E emulation chain, the cited solution describes SMW200A as the signal generator / channel emulator rather than assigning a specific FSW/FSVA analyzer measurement role.[5][68] | R&S Space Nexus is described as PC software, available on request, that generates SMW200A fading files based on satellite trajectory; its formal version, license, ordering information, and output format are not marked.[5][8] |
| 【推論】NTN component and Satellite Access Node testing turns the market need for NTN payload / access-node validation into measurable RF transmitter, receiver, performance, and OTA characteristics; the Signal Generator needs NTN/NR waveform, fading, AWGN, propagation, SISO/MIMO capability, and the Signal Analyzer needs high-frequency, wide-band signal analysis and SAN transmitter measurement support. | SAN conformance chapters cover conducted transmitter, conducted receiver, conducted performance, radiated transmitter, radiated receiver, and radiated performance characteristics.[57] | For SAN testing, R&S SMW200A provides FRCs, TMs, fading module, AWGN module, static UE propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, NB‑IoT options K119/K115/K143/K146, NR options K144/K148/K171, and B14/B15 + K71 moving propagation.[66] | For component testing, R&S FSW is listed with frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz, and LTE / Cellular IoT / 5G NR R17/18 / OFDM / vector signal analysis software; FSW / FSVA 5G NR options support SAN Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 measurements.[67][57] | The NTN signal-generator source is a 2025 solution-level presentation, not a formal datasheet, configuration guide, price book, or 3GPP specification.[64] |

NTN signal generator solutions
[[NTN signal generator solutions]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025；末頁標示 Last updated: 08/25）中用來整理 [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]] 與相關 software options 在 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] 測試中的 solution-level 應用框架。

NTN signal generator solutions › End-to-end system testing
來源將 E2E system testing 描述為對 UE、NTN payload、service link channel emulator 與 feeder link channel emulator 的 RF satellite link emulation。[[R&S SMW200A]] 需要 firmware version ≥ 5.30，並透過 B14 或 B15 搭配 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 支援：

- satellite trajectory modelling。
- frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- longer path delays。
- enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- up to 1073 ms delay。
- up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

[[R&S Space Nexus]] 在來源中被描述為 PC Software，available on request，可依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files。

詳見 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

NTN signal generator solutions › 與 NTN validation / conformance 的關係
- [[5G NTN validation and testing]]：較寬的 NTN validation、partner collaboration、CMX500 / SMBV100B / Viasat / Gatehouse / MediaTek PR 語境。
- [[NR-NTN conformance testing]]：偏 UE / GCF / PTCRB / TS8980 / CMX500 conformance validation。
- [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]：本來源新增的 Satellite Access Node 測試概念，聚焦 SAN transmitter、receiver、performance 與 OTA chapters。
- [[NTN propagation emulation and fading]]：既有 CMX500 PR 中 propagation emulation 與 fading 的概念；本來源補充 SMW200A dynamic fading / Doppler / path delay 實作線索。

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › 重點摘要
此來源是由 `3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR.pptx` 轉出的 lossy markdown；封面標示 `1GP` 與 `12-2025`，末頁標示 `Last updated: 08/25`，其中 slide 27 另標示 `2025-09-29 Nokia Workshop at R&S - SigGen Product Update`。本頁以來源原文呈現的 2025 年簡報語境處理，不自行推論正式發布日。

簡報主題是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 針對 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] 的 signal generator / channel emulation 測試方案，涵蓋：

- [[5G NTN-NR]] 的 Release 17 / 18 / 19 演進與頻段。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）conformance testing。
- [[NTN signal generator solutions]] 的 component testing、SAN testing、end-to-end system testing 與 UE testing 分層。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 作為 channel emulator / signal generator 的 NTN 測試能力。
- [[R&S FSW]] 與 [[R&S FSVA3000]] 在 component testing / SAN transmitter measurement 中的角色。
- [[R&S Space Nexus]] 依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files 的待請求 PC software 線索。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 標示 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18，但未提供 release date、release notes、license requirement 或相容性矩陣。
- [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 使用 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的語句，但未展開 compliance 的測試項目、標準版本、認證機構或是否等同正式 conformance / certification testing。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 來源中的測試架構
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 提供 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。
- 測試目標為 MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[Bluetest]] expanded its earlier integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 此能力與 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS 組成 single tester and reverberation test system 的 integrated path。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可 combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 整合 enables support of [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 non-cellular technologies including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- [[EMITE]] customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] as well as [[5G RedCap]] devices。

- unresolved：來源未標示新聞稿發布日期；raw frontmatter 的 created 為 2026-09-11，但不可視為新聞稿發布日。

- unresolved：來源未標示 [[R&S CMX500]] 此 Wi-Fi 7 integration 所需 software option code、minimum CSW version、硬體配置、RF chains 數量或 order number。

NTN test and measurement aspects › 使用限制
- 本頁是 T&M 技術總覽；正式 test methods、limits、tolerances、test case IDs 與 validation status 需查 [[TS 38.101-5]]、[[TS 38.521-5]]、[[TS 38.523]]、[[TS 38.533]]、[[TS 38.181]]、[[TS 38.108]]、GCF / PTCRB public documents。
- R&S 產品能力需以正式 datasheet / configuration guide 為準；白皮書中的 solution-level 描述不可直接作為 quote / BOM / orderable capability。
- OTA / PAAM setup 的 fixtures、antenna modules、chamber dimensions、quiet zone、polarization、frequency conversions 等需以原圖與 setup note 回查。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation
[[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025）中描述的 end-to-end NTN system testing 方法：用 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 fading / channel emulation 功能模擬 service link 與 feeder link 的 RF satellite link，並透過 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 或 [[R&S Space Nexus]] 產生 trajectory-based fading files。

SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation › 使用限制
- 來源為 2025 簡報，不是 [[R&S SMW200A]] specifications 或 fading option datasheet。
- dynamic fading / Doppler / path delay 數字需回查正式 SMW200A fading specifications 與 relevant application note。
- slide 28 多個欄位空白或無法可靠辨識；本頁不補推 missing values。
- [[R&S Space Nexus]] 的正式 version、license、ordering information、output file format、trajectory source、supported orbit 與 availability 條件未標示。
- 此頁不等同 [[NTN propagation emulation and fading]] 中 CMX500 PR 對 propagation emulation / fading 的術語區分。

SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation › E2E system testing 架構
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 24，E2E system testing 圖中包含：

- UE。
- Channel emulator for service link。
- NTN payload。
- Channel emulator for feeder link。
- 圖上另標示兩組 2 paths。

來源將此歸為 [[NTN signal generator solutions]] 的 End-to-end System Testing 類別。

CMX500 NTN one-box tester › NTN challenges covered by the PR
來源將 NTN 測試挑戰歸納為：

- Rapid satellite movement。
- [[Doppler frequency shift]]。
- variable propagation delay。
- high path loss。
- advanced channel emulation。
- multiple orbits：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]。
- multiple frequency bands。
- NTN often necessitates [[FDD]] instead of [[TDD]] common in terrestrial networks。

[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 multi-orbit 與 complete channel emulation in one box 說法與上述 PR 層級方向一致，但未提供細項參數。

CMX500 NTN one-box tester › Conformance / carrier acceptance claim
來源宣稱：

- [[R&S CMX500]] is industry-leading in conformance testing。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] supports NTN conformance and carrier acceptance testing。
- 來源稱其 offering the highest number of validated test cases for [[NR-NTN]] according to [[3GPP Release 17]]。
- Validations were conducted across [[PCT]]、[[RF]] 與 [[RRM]] domains。

使用限制：來源未列 test case IDs、數量、validation date、validation body、test specification version、DUT 或比較對象。因此這些 statements 只能作為 PR claim，不可替代 conformance test package database 或 formal validation report。

CMX500 NTN one-box tester › 來源定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester has evolved into a versatile, all-in-one platform for NTN testing。
- 來源明示 supported technologies：[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]]（D2C / DTC）。
- 來源宣稱 users can test all NTN technologies on both network and device level without multiple instruments。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將於 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] booth 5A80 / hall 5 展示 upgraded one-box tester，活動期間為 2026-03-02 至 2026-03-05。

依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]：

- Comprehensive support for NR-NTN。
- Multi-orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- Complete channel emulation in one box。
- Live graphics for NTN orbits and parameters。
- NB-NTN coming end of `25。
- Option 線索：[[R&S CMX-KS627B]] NR Signaling Extension Rel-17。

此處的 one-box tester 是 PR / solution positioning 與簡報 use-case 語彙；正式 hardware configuration、software option stack、measurement specification 與 order number 仍需回 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]、[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]、[[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]] 與正式 configurator。

NTN propagation emulation and fading
[[NTN propagation emulation and fading]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026]] 中用來區分 satellite space-to-ground effects 與 terrestrial impairments 的測試概念；來源宣稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 可將兩者分開建模與控制，以支援更 accurate and flexible 的 NTN scenario testing。

NTN propagation emulation and fading › 使用限制
- 來源是 PR，不是 channel model specification、measurement application note 或 formal datasheet。
- 來源未提供 propagation emulation 與 fading 的正式模型名稱、3GPP clause、parameter range、implementation architecture、supported bands、supported orbit profiles 或 calibration method。
- 來源宣稱 only available NTN test solution，但未提供競品清單、比較日期或 benchmark 方法。
- 不可由本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 的正式 fading option、channel emulator 規格、measurement uncertainty 或 conformance coverage。

NTN propagation emulation and fading › 來源中的區分
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026]]，[[R&S CMX500]] is the only available [[NTN]] test solution that differentiates between propagation emulation and fading。

來源將 effects 區分為：

| 類別 | 來源描述 |
|---|---|
| space-to-ground effects | Doppler、delay、scattering |
| terrestrial impairments | reflections、receiver-induced Doppler |

來源主張這種區分讓 space-to-ground effects and terrestrial impairments 可以 independently modeled and controlled。

NTN 裝置法規測試 › EN 303 981 測試與 solution mapping
來源指出 [[EN 303 981]]使用 radiated measurement for antenna characterizations，並列出 test cases：

- Antenna beam pointing。
- Off / on-axis spurious radiation。
- Carrier suppression / cessation of missions。
- Blocking performance。
- Adjacent Signal Selectivity。
- Image frequency rejection。
- Location and Identification of the WBES。
- Control and Monitoring Functions。
- Receive antenna off-axis gain pattern。

Required instruments / solution mapping 包含：

- Signal generator for CW and unwanted signal，30 MHz–60 GHz。
- [[R&S SMBV100B]]。
- [[R&S ELEKTRA]]。
- [[R&S TS8996]] RSE & customization。

NTN 裝置法規測試 › EN 301 681 測試與 solution mapping
來源指出 [[EN 301 681]] measurements are preferred conducted，並列出 test cases：

- Unwanted emissions outside the band。
- Unwanted emissions within the band。
- Unwanted emissions in carrier-off state。
- Protection of the radio astronomy service operation 1660 to 1660.5 MHz and 1668 to 1670 MHz。
- Receiver Adjacent Channel Selectivity。
- Receiver Blocking Characteristics。
- MES Control and Monitoring Function / CMF processor monitoring。
- Equipment identity。

Typical setup / required instruments 包含：

- Spectrum analyzer 30 MHz–12.75 GHz。
- Signal generator for CW and unwanted signal。
- BER measure。
- System emulator / Mobile Radio Tester。
- Test load、filter、coupler、RF interference signal generator。
- [[R&S SMBV100B]]。
- 來源稱 latest [[R&S CMW500]] SW can support 3GPP R17 NB-NTN signalling。

NTN 裝置法規測試 › unresolved
- 來源未標示 EN 301 681、EN 303 981 等 standards 的版本與修訂日期。
- Product examples 是圖表中的 market examples / Declaration of Conformity 線索，未提供 DoC 文件、日期或地區。
- Latest CMW500 SW support 3GPP R17 NB-NTN signalling 未提供 software version、option、test case 或 supported band。
- CE RED / ETSI / FCC regulation adaptation 的正式 work items 未標示。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 與 NR-NTN conformance testing 的區分
[[NR-NTN conformance testing]] 既有頁主要整理 [[GCF]] [[WI-555]]、[[PTCRB]] [[RFT 555]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]、[[R&S TS-RRM]]、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 UE / chipset conformance validation PR 語境。

本頁的 [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 則聚焦 [[Satellite Access Node]]、[[3GPP TS 38.108]] / [[3GPP TS 38.181]]、SAN transmitter / receiver / performance / OTA chapters，以及 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator / channel emulator 配置。兩者同屬 NTN conformance testing，但測試對象、規格與儀器角色不同。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 測試對象與架構
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 18，測試對象是 Satellite Access Node（DUT），transparent payload architecture。圖中文字包含：

- Gateway。
- NTN Payload RF。
- gNB。
- Feeder Link Emulator。
- Signal generator。
- Channel emulator for service link。
- Throughput measurement point。

來源 slide 6 說 [[3GPP]] Specification Work in Release 17 and Release 18 focuses on transparent bent-pipe payload architecture。SAN provides NR user plane and control plane protocol terminations towards NTN satellite-capable UE，connected via NG interface to 5GC，and encompasses a transparent NTN payload onboard a NTN platform、a gateway and gNB functions。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › SAN conformance requirements chapters
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 33：

- Chapter 6：Conducted transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 7：Conducted receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 8：Conducted performance characteristics。
- Chapter 9：Radiated transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 10：Radiated receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 11：Radiated performance characteristics。

來源同頁說 5G NR options on [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]] support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements。

SatelliteEcoChain › 與既有知識的關係
- [[4. Satellite Eco-chain in Taiwan]] 是 OneNote link hub，先前只列出 `SatelliteEcoChain.xlsx` 與外部網頁 / 圖片待讀；本來源是同名 Excel 經 markitdown 轉出的表格內容，因此補足部分待讀材料。

SatelliteEcoChain › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[台灣衛星產業鏈 R&S solution mapping]] — 本來源最直接支撐的概念頁，整理 satellite eco-chain 表格分類、企業列名、R&S solution mapping 與使用限制。

- [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、[[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]、[[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] — 表格中的 G/T、NPR、Group delay、DVB-S2/S2X 與 R&S 儀器 mapping 可連到既有衛星測試主題。

NTN signal generator solutions › SAN testing
來源將 SAN testing 連到 [[3GPP TS 38.108]]、[[3GPP TS 38.181]]、[[3GPP TS 36.108]] 與 [[3GPP TS 36.181]]。在 signal generator 角度，[[R&S SMW200A]] 提供：

- SISO / MIMO。
- NB-IoT options：K119 / K115 / K143 / K146。

詳見 [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]。

NTN signal generator solutions › Component testing
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 16，component testing 使用 DUT、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S FSW]]：

- [[R&S SMW200A]]：frequency up to 67 GHz，overrange 72 GHz；RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz，up to 4 GHz with [[R&S SMW-K555]]。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generation SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal generation（K114）、custom digital modulation。
- [[R&S FSW]]：frequency up to 85 GHz，overrange 90 GHz；analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz。
- [[R&S FSW]] signal analysis SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal analysis（K96）、Vector signal analysis（K70）。

以上是 2025 簡報摘要值；正式產品規格仍需回查 [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]] 與其對應 specifications。

- Flexible definition of terrestrial channel profiles；B14 or B15 required。
- Customized dynamic fading；K820 required。
- Model satellite trajectory。
- Account for frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- Longer path delays and enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- Up to 1073 ms delay。
- Up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

R&S SMW200A › 主要 RF performance（Version 31.00，May 2026）
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Frequency range：依 RF path frequency option，RF path A 最高 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`；RF path B 最高 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- Overrange：`67 GHz to 72 GHz`。
- Resolution of setting：`0.001 Hz`。
- Resolution of synthesis：`0.053 nHz nominal`，條件 `f = 1 GHz`。
- Frequency setting time：依 frequency option 為 `< 1.2 ms` 至 `< 1.8 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` 為 `< 4.0 ms`。條件包含 GUI update stopped、I/Q optimization mode fast、after IEC/IEEE bus delimiter、HUMS off。
- Frequency setting time in list mode：依 frequency option為 `< 0.8 ms` 至 `< 1.4 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721`、run mode live 為 `< 4.0 ms`。
- Level setting range：`100 kHz ≤ f < 1 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +8 dBm`；`1 MHz ≤ f < 3 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +13 dBm`；`3 MHz ≤ f ≤ 67 GHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +30 dBm`。
- Standard performance SSB phase noise 條件：CW，carrier offset `20 kHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 Hz`，level `10 dBm` 或 maximum specified output power 兩者較低者；`f = 1 GHz` 為 `< –134 dBc`，typ. `–140 dBc`。
- `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` ultra low phase noise 在 `1 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–144 dBc`，typ. `–150 dBc`；在 `67 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–105 dBc`，typ. `–111 dBc`。
- Pulse modulation 需 `R&S®SMW-K22`；一般 on/off ratio `> 80 dB`，部分高頻條件例外為 `> 65 dB`。
- Pulse rise/fall time（10 % / 90 % of RF amplitude）：低頻 frequency options fast transition `< 10 ns`；多數 20 GHz 以上 options fast transition `< 15 ns`；smoothed transition 多數條件 `< 200 ns`。
- Internal baseband I/Q、wideband baseband (`R&S®SMW-B13XT`)、I/Q wideband on：`f > 2.5 GHz` 時 `±1 GHz`；RF modulation bandwidth 可達 `2 GHz`。

R&S CMX500 › NR FR1
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM600 是 frequency range 1 對 NR uplink signals 執行任何 TX tests 的必要 option。NR FR1 uplink measurements 包含 multi-evaluation、PRACH、SRS、TPC measurement。Multi-evaluation 支援 NR channel bandwidth **3 MHz 到 100 MHz**，可分析 FDD 與 TDD signals、NR standalone signals 與 intraband contiguous EN-DC signals。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，R&S CMX-KM600 option 的 5G NR analyzer 條件為 FR1、SCS 30 kHz、16QAM、temperature range +15 °C to +35 °C；input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。Frequency measurement uncertainty：**< 20 Hz + drift of timebase**；相對於同一台 CMX500 device 的 downlink signal 進行 frequency error measurements 時，uncertainty 符合 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] V18.5.0。

- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。

[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

- 同一來源稱電信業具寡占特性、服務差異化程度低，容易引發價格戰。
- 同一來源稱因美國對中國網通品牌的禁令與小型基地台需求增加，台灣網通廠逐步從透過品牌商供貨轉型為直接供應電信營運商。
- 同一來源稱 [[智易]]、[[中磊]]、[[啟碁]]在直供電信商轉型中受惠較明顯。

### Chain map
| Wireless Communication market requirement | Measurable parameter / test need | Required capability of Signal Generator | Required capability of Signal Analyzer | Evidence / limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 【推論】Wi‑Fi 7 ODM/OEM demand is driven by IEEE 802.11be upgrades including 320 MHz channel bandwidth, 4096‑QAM, MLO, 6 GHz, and thermal design issues; the measurable parameters are 320 MHz bandwidth, 4096‑QAM modulation, and MLO / multiple RF chains; the Signal Generator side needs IEEE 802.11be waveform capability and RF modulation bandwidth that covers 320 MHz, while the Signal Analyzer side needs WLAN/802.11be analysis plus analysis bandwidth that covers 320 MHz. | 320 MHz channel bandwidth, 4096‑QAM, MLO / multiple RF chains, and 6 GHz operation are listed as Wi‑Fi 7 technical requirements or test challenges.[25][95] | R&S SMW200A product facts confirm internal digital standards include IEEE 802.11be, and its wideband baseband can provide up to 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth.[73][10] | R&S FSW product facts confirm WLAN options include K91BE, and analysis bandwidth options include R&S FSW‑B320 for 320 MHz analysis bandwidth.[79][80] | The passages do not directly state a SMW200A Wi‑Fi 7 320 MHz test configuration or option stack, and the Wi‑Fi 7 market page should not be merged with R&S solution pages as a verified product-market fit.[38] |
| 【推論】LEO / Direct‑to‑Cell / NTN demand requires RF satellite-link emulation; the measurable parameters are long path delay, Doppler, pathloss, atmospheric effects, and trajectory-dependent fading; the Signal Generator / channel-emulator side needs dynamic fading, long delay, Doppler, and trajectory-based fading-file support. | NTN testing must add high path loss, Doppler shift, time delay, delay variance, atmospheric effects, Faraday effect, scintillation, and weather influences.[42] | R&S SMW200A NTN E2E testing requires firmware version ≥ 5.30 and B14 or B15 with R&S SMW‑K820 customized dynamic fading, supporting satellite trajectory modeling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, longer path delays, enhanced Doppler, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler.[5] | For this E2E emulation chain, the cited solution describes SMW200A as the signal generator / channel emulator rather than assigning a specific FSW/FSVA analyzer measurement role.[5][68] | R&S Space Nexus is described as PC software, available on request, that generates SMW200A fading files based on satellite trajectory; its formal version, license, ordering information, and output format are not marked.[5][8] |

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › SAN conformance requirements chapters
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 33：

- Chapter 6：Conducted transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 7：Conducted receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 8：Conducted performance characteristics。
- Chapter 9：Radiated transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 10：Radiated receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 11：Radiated performance characteristics。

來源同頁說 5G NR options on [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]] support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements。

NTN signal generator solutions › 使用限制
- 來源是 2025 簡報與 OneNote 轉檔，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、price book 或 3GPP specification。
- 來源標示 12-2025、Last updated 08/25 與 2025-09-29 workshop date；正式發布日期未標示。
- 來源中的 recommended configurations 不能直接視為可報價 BOM；需回查正式 configuration guide、option availability、export control 與 service plan。
- 來源中的 R17/18 option wording 不可直接覆寫正式 product option name；正式命名仍以產品規格書為準。

NTN signal generator solutions › SAN testing
來源將 SAN testing 連到 [[3GPP TS 38.108]]、[[3GPP TS 38.181]]、[[3GPP TS 36.108]] 與 [[3GPP TS 36.181]]。在 signal generator 角度，[[R&S SMW200A]] 提供：

- Fixed Reference Channels（FRCs）。
- Test Models（TMs）。
- Fading Module。
- AWGN Module。
- static UE propagation models。
- TDL and moving propagation。
- SISO / MIMO。
- NB-IoT options：K119 / K115 / K143 / K146。
- NR options：K144 / K148 / K171。
- B14 / B15 + K71 moving propagation。

詳見 [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]。

NTN signal generator solutions › Component testing
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 16，component testing 使用 DUT、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S FSW]]：

- [[R&S SMW200A]]：frequency up to 67 GHz，overrange 72 GHz；RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz，up to 4 GHz with [[R&S SMW-K555]]。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generation SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal generation（K114）、custom digital modulation。
- [[R&S FSW]]：frequency up to 85 GHz，overrange 90 GHz；analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz。
- [[R&S FSW]] signal analysis SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal analysis（K96）、Vector signal analysis（K70）。

以上是 2025 簡報摘要值；正式產品規格仍需回查 [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]] 與其對應 specifications。

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › NTN end-to-end system testing
來源 slide 24–28 說 E2E system testing 會以 channel emulator for service link 與 channel emulator for feeder link 模擬 UE、NTN payload 之間的 RF satellite link。

來源 slide 25 標示 `SMW firmware version ≥ 5.30`，key features 包含：

- Flexible definition of terrestrial channel profiles；B14 or B15 required。
- Customized dynamic fading；K820 required。
- Model satellite trajectory。
- Account for frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- Longer path delays and enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- Up to 1073 ms delay。
- Up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

來源 slide 26 對 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 的 E2E testing key features：customer-provided list、flexible definition of satellite movement、possibility to account for frequency-dependent atmospheric effects、longer path delays and enhanced Doppler capabilities。Key parameters：update interval、delay、Doppler、pathloss。

來源 slide 27 說 [[R&S Space Nexus]] 是 PC Software，available on request，可 generate SMW200A fading files based on a satellite trajectory；key parameters 同為 update interval、delay、Doppler、pathloss。
